Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.
Card Q&A.q: When I have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name and my opponent has 1 Digimon with 6000 DP and 1 with 4000 DP, can I choose the target to delete with this card's effect from these 2 Digimon?

Effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. If you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP instead.
